title.description: Short title for a new task; never used to join an old task.

goal.description: Goal for a newly created task.

expectedRevision.description: Required for mutations and paginated note read after the first page. Use the note revision for append, or the work revision from read_plan for plan mutations.

goals.description: define_plan subgoals [{id,description}] under the existing task goal; ids use lowercase kebab-case, maximum 20.

itemId.description: Explicit work item id for block_item/reopen_item, or read_plan to inspect one complete item including its scopes, description, owning attempt and prior outcome.

reason.description: Reason for blocking or reopening work; not permission to waive verification.

entry.description: Append note {kind,text,refs?}; kinds: progress, evidence, decision, blocker, next_step, run. Text at most 4000 characters; context only, never approval.

limit.description: Page size from 1 to 20; defaults to 10.

cursor.description: Read offset into newest-first history; use nextCursor with the same expectedRevision.
